skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — trim the silent gaps and cut the clip down to 2 minutes — and get trimmed...

latestVersion.changelog:
Trimmer Adobe 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly trim and export video clips via simple user instructions—no editing software knowledge required.
- Supports uploading MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files (up to 500MB) for cloud-based AI video trimming.
- Automatic connection and authentication with the cloud backend (100 free credits, 7-day trial for new users).
- Offers rapid rendering on remote GPU nodes, returning processed videos in 30–90 seconds.
- Built-in commands for uploading, trimming, exporting, checking credits, and monitoring status.
- Clear error handling, workflow tips, and support for seamless iterative video editing.
